summary: De Gym Muay Thai Phuket is a Muay Thai-only gym in Phuket that opened in April 2025, with two air-conditioned bungalows for long-stay trainees.

facts.label: Opened
facts.quote: DE GYM MUAY THAI PHUKET ha aperto l’1 aprile 2025

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.value: Two air-conditioned bungalows with Wi-Fi for athletes staying long periods
facts.quote: 2 bungalow con aria condizionata e Wi-Fi per ospitare gli atleti che vogliono dormire nel campo per lunghi periodi
